results.title: iF DESIGN STUDENT AWARD 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Official page: open to student design concepts worldwide, free entry; an undergraduate Visual/Interaction Design major qualifies. Concept must map to one UN SDG (1-15). No nationality/visa bar — EU citizen, France-based is fine.
results.notes: Exploit layer (direct design-award match). EUR 50,000 prize fund; ceremony NYC June 2027.

results.title: Global Game Jam 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Official page: free, worldwide, all ages and skill levels; students join online or at a local site. No nationality/visa bar. A design student with a game interest qualifies; jammer registration opens 1 Dec 2026.
results.notes: Hobby/explore layer (low-bar game jam; strong Blender/Figma portfolio exercise). Jam runs 25-31 Jan 2027.

results.title: Annecy Festival 2027 - Graduation / Short Film competition
results.organization: CITIA - Annecy International Animation Film Festival
results.eligibility_notes: Official site confirms the 2027 festival (13-19 June 2027) and a graduation/short-film competitive section, but the 2027 submission call status was not confirmed on the fetched page (secondary sources say it opens ~fall 2026, deadline ~Feb 2027). A 3rd-year design student with an animation film could enter the student/graduation category. Entry fee ~EUR 30 (shorts/graduation). Student-status rule not re-read this run.
results.notes: Exploit layer (animation/film interest). Verify call opening and exact student-category rules on the Annecy Network portal before submitting.

results.title: PRIMA - concours étudiant en Design & Architecture
results.eligibility_notes: Official organizer site runs a student Design & Architecture competition; the 2026 edition was open (info session Feb 2026). Exact 2026/2027 deadline and eligibility (student year, possible Hauts-de-France regional scope) were not re-read this run — verify on prima-cb.com. A France-based design student likely qualifies.
results.notes: Exploit layer (France + design). Verify edition and deadline on the official site.

results.title: Bourse Créateur numérique - Fondation Jean-Luc Lagardère
results.eligibility_notes: Secondary source: EUR 15,000 Digital Creation grant, under 30, any nationality, French-language project required, individual or team up to 3; a design student with a digital/animation project qualifies. EU citizen, France-based - no nationality bar. The 2026 deadline (21 June) passed; 2027 dates not yet confirmed on the official site.
results.notes: Funding/adjacent layer (digital creation, animation). Official foundation homepage confirms the digital-creation bourse programme; amounts and 2027 dates from a secondary aggregator, unconfirmed.

results.title: Créart'UP - dispositif projets étudiants (Ville de Paris)
results.organization: Maison étudiante de la Ville de Paris
results.eligibility_notes: Official Paris city page: Créart'UP funds bold student artistic/cultural projects (incl. design, visual/audiovisual arts, cultural apps/tools) for students in Paris/Île-de-France or graduates within 2 years. A France-based design student with a project likely qualifies; the 2026-2027 deadline and full rules were not deep-read this run - verify on maison-etudiante.paris.
results.notes: Project layer (France, design project funding/incubation). Confirm the Île-de-France residency rule.

results.title: UNDP Remote Graphic & Web Design Internship
results.eligibility_notes: Aggregator: remote graphic/web design internship, open to all nationalities currently enrolled in a bachelor's or higher; bachelor students must be in their final year. Persona is L3 (final year of a 3-yr licence, graduating 2028-06) and an EU citizen - likely meets the final-year and nationality conditions. Requires full-time availability; the official UNDP portal was not verified this run.
results.notes: Career/remote layer (adjacent). Verify on the official UNDP careers portal; aggregator deadline 6 June 2027 is unconfirmed.

run_notes: Corrected Mode-B OpportunityRadar run after the persona data-shape bug was fixed. locales.py now resolves regions=france, primary=fr-FR, optional=en, so France-based items were searched in French and remote/global items in English only. Covered 6 categories (competition, funding, project, career, hobby, event) with exploit/adjacent/explore layering. Two items verified at Tier-A official pages (iF Design Student Award 2027, Global Game Jam 2027); Annecy and PRIMA partially verified on official organizer sites; Lagardere, Creart'UP and UNDP remain unverified (secondary/snippet only, flagged). Three expired 2026 items excluded with reasons. No URLs invented; expired/uncertain items not recommended as open.
